image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: An Air Force base perimeter gate vs internal hallways (Extracted from the hook: 'Security models like an Air Force base')
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Wide-angle isometric shot of a complex security gate made of heavy steel bars with a single guard station, transitioning into a vast, open-plan office interior where people move freely without barriers.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A castle where every individual stone is guarded (Extracted from the hook: 'Trust NO ONE, not even your friends inside')
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Extreme high-angle bird's-eye view of a medieval-style stone castle where every single inhabitant is standing inside their own individual, transparent glass containment cube, isolated from one another.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A person trying to fit a massive pile of keys into a tiny, single-keyhole door (Extracted from the hook: 'Harder to do in practice than you might think')
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Close-up side profile shot of a hand holding a massive, heavy ring of hundreds of mismatched keys, struggling to select just one small, precise key to fit into a single, minimalist door lock.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A stone tablet with permanent, carved entries (Extracted from the hook: 'Accounting book written in permanent ink')
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Extreme macro shot of a heavy, ancient stone ledger lying on a metal desk, with glowing blue digital data streams etched deeply into the rock surface, impossible to erase.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A person wearing distinct, interchangeable masks (Extracted from the hook: 'BruinLearn roles like student, TA, instructor')
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Medium depth-of-field shot of a person standing at a crossroads, holding three distinct, stylized geometric masks, each representing a different role, with the person choosing which mask to wear to enter a specific gate.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: Two isolated rooms connected by a thin, vibrating pipe (Extracted from the hook: 'Programs separated by a wall whispering secrets')
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Split-view cross-section shot of two identical, soundproofed concrete rooms separated by a thick, opaque wall, with a single, thin, vibrating copper wire snaking through a tiny crack in the wall between them.
